*What did you do?*

Currently, `cancelCtx` uses map to store all child contexts  
<https://github.com/golang/go/blob/c85695a117f1ec3b800ba14570876cfcd2075c1f/src/context/context.go#L265-L275|https://github.com/golang/go/blob/c85695a117f1ec3b800ba14570876cfcd2075c1f/src/context/context.go#L265-L275>

But it causes map allocation and may be ineffective if there is only one child context. This case is quite common, at least in my projects.

I made a simple patch which stores first child in separate field (<https://github.com/tdakkota/go/commit/1c4f3b2e64aeda0439217b50ffcd996e324f6e1f|tdakkota/go@1c4f3b2>) and see an improvement.
